records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

We haven't seen much activity on Silver Dynamics' account yet. If priorities shifted, no worries -- but if you're still interested, I'm glad to help you get moving.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

How's Wrenfield treating you this week? If there's a specific workflow you're trying to replicate from your old tool, I'm happy to help map it over.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have Silver Dynamics here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no project, no invite, no reply to two outreach emails (email:ee56c5ed, email:f453ce5f) and zero tickets — no signal of engagement. Pro plan and active subscription give some upside, but silent accounts with no first project rarely self-start within 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Checking back in after my note last week. Most teams get their footing once there's a first project in place — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get that first project set up around whatever workflow you're moving over from your old tool.

Best,
Nadia
